back_to_maker.instruction: Icon designer, option B (clarity 3). Redraw B so it reads as homes for more than one household and stops reading as one house or a public building. Keep the pitched roof, the ground line and the three floors. Replace the single red arched door with two plain square-headed doors side by side at the ground line, red on one, with a column of two windows over each, so the front reads as two homes under one roof. Keep it clear of CL-031's and R-31's arched red doorway and of CL-054's single house, and keep the line, the cap and 21 units to every tile edge. Rerun the likeness check against the set and against A and C, and give your naming reading at 48 px. If the redraw still reads first as one house at 48 px, withdraw B and let the card show A and C with the reason printed, as the stage B short cards did.
